knowledge:
- key_parameters: <pwm1=First position weight matrix (matrix or data.frame) ;; pwm2=Second position weight matrix (matrix or data.frame) ;; align_pwms=Logical indicating whether to align PWMs of different lengths before comparison ;; stackHeight=Function to compute stack height in custom sequence logos (e.g., sumProbabilities) ;; alphabet=Alphabet used for the motifs (e.g., FULL_ALPHABET for amino acids) ;; sampleSizes=Vector of sequence counts/sample sizes for each PWM, used to calculate and display significant differences with asterisks ;; n1=Sample size (sequence count) for pwm1 ;; n2=Sample size (sequence count) for pwm2>
- alternatives: <seqLogo::seqLogo=Used for plotting classic sequence logos, but DiffLogo::seqLogo should be preferred when custom stack height or base distribution functions are needed>
- when_to_use: <When comparing transcription factor binding sites (TFBS) or protein motifs across different conditions, species, or variants, especially when motifs have different lengths or require statistical significance testing of position-wise differences>
- pitfalls: <Input PWMs must be of class matrix or data.frame; if not, the package will attempt to convert them and print a warning. When comparing motifs of different lengths, failing to set align_pwms=TRUE or manually aligning them first will lead to errors or incorrect comparisons.>

workflows.name: pairwise_motif_comparison
workflows.intent: Compare two PWMs (of the same or different lengths), optionally align them, calculate statistical significance of differences, and plot the pairwise difference logo.
workflows.stages: 1. Load PWMs from files ;; 2. Create a difference logo object ;; 3. Enrich the difference logo object with p-values using sample sizes ;; 4. Plot the difference logo (or directly plot using diffLogoFromPwm with alignment if lengths differ)
workflows.code:
diffLogoFromPwm(pwm1 = pwm1, pwm2 = pwm2)

## diffLogoFromPwm is a convenience function for
diffLogoObj = createDiffLogoObject(pwm1 = pwm1, pwm2 = pwm2)
diffLogo(diffLogoObj)

## mark symbol stacks with significant changes
diffLogoObj = enrichDiffLogoObjectWithPvalues(diffLogoObj, n1, n2)
diffLogo(diffLogoObj)

## plot DiffLogo for PWMs of different length
diffLogoFromPwm(pwm1 = pwm_long, pwm2 = pwm_short, align_pwms=TRUE)

workflows.name: multiple_motif_comparison_table
workflows.intent: Compare multiple motifs simultaneously by generating a grid/table of pairwise difference logos, optionally indicating significant differences.
workflows.stages: 1. Load multiple PWMs into a list ;; 2. Generate and plot a table of difference logos, optionally specifying the alphabet or sample sizes for significance asterisks
workflows.code:
## plot table of difference logos for CTFC motifs (DNA)
diffLogoTable(PWMs = motifs_dna)
## plot table of difference logos for E-Box motifs (DNA)
diffLogoTable(PWMs = motifs_dna2)
## plot table of difference logos for F-Box motifs (ASN)
diffLogoTable(PWMs = motifs_asn, alphabet = FULL_ALPHABET)
## CTFC motifs (DNA) with asterisks to indicate significant differences
diffLogoTable(PWMs = motifs_dna, sampleSizes = sampleSizes_dna)

workflows.name: multiple_pwm_alignment
workflows.intent: Align multiple PWMs of different lengths and visualize the unaligned vs. aligned sequence logos.
workflows.stages: 1. Perform multiple local alignment of PWMs ;; 2. Extend the PWMs based on the alignment vector ;; 3. Plot the unaligned and aligned sequence logos
workflows.code:
## align pwms and than plot seqLogo of them
pwms = list(pwm_long, pwm_short)
multiple_pwms_alignment = multipleLocalPwmsAlignment(pwms)
aligned_pwms = extendPwmsFromAlignmentVector(pwms, multiple_pwms_alignment$alignment$vector)

## seqLogo of aligned pwms
layout(mat = matrix(data = 1:4, nrow = 2, ncol = 2))
DiffLogo::seqLogo(pwms[[1]], main = "Unaligned")
DiffLogo::seqLogo(pwms[[2]])
DiffLogo::seqLogo(aligned_pwms[[1]], main = "Aligned")
DiffLogo::seqLogo(aligned_pwms[[2]])
